status_at_creation: Before downloading or visually inspecting manuscript page images; catalogue metadata and image link inventory exposed.

selection.manuscript: Columbia University Rare Book and Manuscript Library MS Or 422
selection.reason: First newly recovered complete, explicitly dated, 15-line Quran with accessible public-domain scans in this continuation. Not randomly selected from historical Qurans.
selection.rule: Six evenly spaced rectos, fixed by foliation rather than target alignment, plus the catalogued colophon 304r for dating inspection.
selection.replacement_rule: No replacement for missing, unreadable, incompatible or zero-name pages. Retain failures.

feasibility_gate: Check item identity, catalogue date versus directly legible colophon, exact folio-to-image mapping and image hashes.
Read first/last canonical verse text and count main-text rows on all six pages; do not assume 15 lines means same page or row contents.
Record whole-token horizontal intervals for every legible Allah-name-form in the main text, including prefixes; omit margin catchwords, notes and headings from the token population.

Compare modern page/row membership for the same canonical tokens, retaining boundary and identification uncertainty. If correspondence fails, report that rather than forcing a matched-layout comparison.

scoring_if_feasible.primary: Allah-name-family endpoints with at least one family partner on a different row of the same historical page; each endpoint counted once.
scoring_if_feasible.secondary: Exact standalone Allah endpoints paired only with exact standalone Allah.
scoring_if_feasible.center: Midpoint of manually read whole-token horizontal ink interval, including prefixes. Main text frame measured independently of name positions.
scoring_if_feasible.distance: Absolute center difference divided by the main text-frame width; primary tolerance 0.02, sensitivity 0.015.
scoring_if_feasible.uncertainty: Retain coordinate uncertainty. An alignment is guaranteed only if every allowed pair of centers passes the threshold; possible if some allowed centers pass. Report endpoint lower/upper bounds rather than force borderline decisions.
scoring_if_feasible.modern_comparison: Use unchanged mapped modern whole-token centers for exactly the same identified canonical occurrences. Report missing modern positions, different page/row assignments and any denominator changes. Do not transfer the original 15px conditional p-values.
scoring_if_feasible.inference: Descriptive exposed-development pilot only. No significance test, origin posterior, corpus-wide historical rate or historical-copy independence claim.

scope: A historical source/compatibility and small annotation pilot. A catalogue and its mirrored exports are one descriptive authority, not independent dating replications. Shared exemplars or intentional older layout remain possible even if historical alignments occur.
execution: Public read-only network requests; no paid OCR or API; local images and raw metadata under logs/historical-copy-ms-or-422-v1/.
